operators.name: SOURCE_RECORD
operators.contract: Preserve canonical source ID, text, type, and gloss without rewriting them.

operators.name: TYPE_DISPATCH
operators.contract: Dispatch only on explicit corpus type values; unknown or absent types remain unresolved.

operators.name: DEFINE_TERM_CANDIDATE
operators.contract: Represent saṃjñā as a definition candidate; do not guess a definiens from token order.

operators.name: REGISTER_POLICY_CANDIDATE
operators.contract: Represent paribhāṣā as interpreter policy, not as a string rewrite.

operators.name: REGISTER_TRANSFER_CANDIDATE
operators.contract: Represent atideśa as a typed transfer candidate; never apply without source, target, and context.

operators.name: SOURCE_ANUVRTTI
operators.contract: Import only anuvṛtti edges explicitly annotated in the source record.

operators.name: FIXED_POINT_INHERITANCE
operators.contract: Propagate explicit anuvṛtti facts monotonically, preserving origin and derivation chain.

operators.name: ADHIKARA_CANDIDATE
operators.contract: Expose inferred scope boundaries for review; do not activate them from locative morphology alone.

operators.name: PRATYAHARA_EXPANSION
operators.contract: Use the position-aware Śivasūtra stream and exclude it-markers from members.

operators.name: SAVARNA_EXPANSION
operators.contract: Expand savarṇa only where the consuming rule licenses it; keep phoneme identity distinct.

operators.name: RULE_APPLICABILITY
operators.contract: Evaluate explicit preconditions before evaluating an operation.

operators.name: RULE_EFFECT
operators.contract: Apply only a fully specified operation; missing maps or semantics yield UNRESOLVED.

operators.name: RULE_CONFLICT
operators.contract: Do not impose global later-rule-wins; require explicit domain, applicability, and conflict relation.

operators.name: PROVENANCE
operators.contract: Every derived fact and applied operation retains source IDs and derivation evidence.

operators.name: STATUS_GATING
operators.contract: Keep candidates distinct from executable-tested rules; serialization never counts as execution.

operators.name: DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT
operators.contract: Return APPLIED, NOT_APPLICABLE, UNRESOLVED, or ERROR; never silently substitute a default.

operators.name: DETERMINISTIC_ORDER
operators.contract: Use canonical source order and explicit ordering constraints, never arbitrary set iteration.

operators.name: ROUND_TERMINATION
operators.contract: Stop fixed-point expansion when a round adds no new provenance-distinct facts, or report limit exhaustion.

lifecycle_contract.candidate: Source has an explicit meta-type; its semantics have not thereby been implemented.
lifecycle_contract.executable: Only a formally specified operation with positive and negative attested tests may be promoted.

source.gloss: शाकल्यस्य (मतेन) सम्बुद्धौ ओत् अनार्षे इतौ प्रगृह्यम्
शाकल्यस्य (मतेन) उञः अनार्षे इतौ प्रगृह्यम् ऊँ
अचः आदेशः परस्मिन् अचि द्विर्वचने पूर्वविधौ स्थानिवत्
अन्त्येन इता सह आदिः स्वस्य रूपस्य
एङ् यस्य अचामादिः तत् प्राचाम् देशे वृद्धम्
उपदेशे अतद्धितस्य  प्रत्ययस्य आदिः ल-श-कु इत्
इयङ्-उवङ्-स्थानौ यू स्त्र्याख्यौ आमि नदी वा, अस्त्री
इयङ्-उवङ्-स्थानौ यू स्त्र्याख्यौ, ह्रस्वः च, ङिति नदी वा, अस्त्री
अन्तर्धौ येन अदर्शनम् इच्छति तत् कारकम् अपादानम्
तानि त्रीणि त्रीणि तिङः एकवचन-द्विवचन-बहुवचनानि एकशः
लोटः लस्य सेः हि अपित् च
लोटः लस्य उत्तमस्य आट् पित् च
वंश्ये जीवति पौत्रप्रभृतेः अपत्यम् तु युवा
ज्यायसि भ्रातरि जीवति पौत्रप्रभृतेः अपत्यम् युवा
भ्रातरि अन्यस्मिन् सपिण्डे स्थविरतरे जीवति पौत्रप्रभृतेः अपत्यम् जीवति (एव) युवा वा ।
